# ui-chat-input

> Chat message input with textarea, submit button, and Enter-to-send behavior.

**Class:** `UIChatInput`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables interaction |
| `no-enter-submit` | `boolean` | Disables Enter key submission |
| `no-auto-clear` | `boolean` | Prevents clearing the textarea after send |

## Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ui-send` | Fired on submit with `{ value }` detail |

## Usage

```html
<ui-chat-input></ui-chat-input>
```
